account.addressNoteHint: So the driver finds you — entrance, floor, buzzer
account.addressesHint: Add an address so you can pick it at checkout.

account.codeSentTo: We sent a six-digit code to {{email}}.

account.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin — this is where the driver comes.
account.mapPinMissing: Not pinned on the map yet

account.loadFailedHint: This does not mean your account is gone. Check your connection and try again.
account.editNameHint: This name is shown to the restaurant and the courier. Past orders keep the name they were placed under. To change your phone number, contact support.

restaurantPanel.title: Restaurant panel
restaurantPanel.commissionExplainer: Commission is charged on the food subtotal only — never on the delivery fee.
restaurantPanel.yourRate: Your commission rate: {{rate}}. The rate is frozen when the order is placed — later changes do not affect past orders.
restaurantPanel.menuSubtitle: Sections, dishes and prices. Changes reach customers straight away.
restaurantPanel.warnDeleteCategory: The “{{name}}” section will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
restaurantPanel.warnDeleteProduct: “{{name}}” will be removed from the menu. Past orders are unaffected.
restaurantPanel.menuEmptyHint: Create a section first — “Döner”, say — then add dishes to it.
restaurantPanel.noProductsFoundHint: Try another word, or clear the search.
restaurantPanel.staffSubtitle: Who can reach the panel, and with what powers.
restaurantPanel.staffAccountHint: They must already have a Qapında account. Ask them to sign up with that phone number first.
restaurantPanel.warnRemoveStaff: {{name}} will be removed from the team and lose access to the panel.
restaurantPanel.noStaffHint: Add someone to the team with the phone number above.
restaurantPanel.settingsSubtitle: Everything a customer sees — the name, the pictures, delivery terms and opening hours.
restaurantPanel.sectionImagesHint: Cover and logo — the first thing a customer sees.
restaurantPanel.sectionHoursHint: No orders are taken on closed days.
restaurantPanel.freeDeliveryHint: Leave empty and delivery is always paid
restaurantPanel.financeSubtitle: Commission, platform-funded discounts and what is due — with the entries behind each figure.
restaurantPanel.priceSeparatorHint: A dot or a comma both work
restaurantPanel.modifierGroupsKept: This dish has {{count}} option group(s). Customers still see them; they are just not edited here.
restaurantPanel.restaurantIdHint: Your restaurant’s unique number. It is what tells two restaurants with the same name apart, and it is also the end of your public link. Quote it when you contact support.
restaurantPanel.pastMoneyNote: A delivered order lands here by itself — there is nothing to press. The commission is posted by an automatic job about {{minutes}} minutes later; the order itself appears in Sales and Finance straight away.
restaurantPanel.publicPhoneHint: Customers see this number and ring it about their order.
restaurantPanel.compareAtPriceHint: Leave empty when the dish is not on offer
restaurantPanel.compareAtPriceInvalid: The price before the discount must be higher than the current price.
restaurantPanel.rejectNotePlaceholder: For example: the chicken has run out, we cannot cook it today
restaurantPanel.rejectNoteHint: Say why in your own words, however briefly.
restaurantPanel.rejectSeenByCustomer: The customer sees this explanation word for word — it is the only answer they get about why the order was not accepted.
restaurantPanel.onlineNotEnabledYet: Online card is not switched on platform-wide yet, so customers are not offered it. It starts working the moment Qapında enables it.
restaurantPanel.noCouriers: This restaurant has no couriers yet. Add one under "Staff" first.
restaurantPanel.requireDeliveryCodeHint: On, the customer is shown a 6-digit code and the courier asks for it at handover. Off, no code is shown and the courier simply marks it delivered. Without a code a "delivered / never arrived" dispute has no evidence — which is why new restaurants start with it on.
restaurantPanel.staffListFailed: Could not load the staff list. Reload the page or sign in again.
restaurantPanel.roleCourierHint: A courier signs in with their own number at /courier.
restaurantPanel.categoriesHint: Choose where you appear on the home page — up to {{max}}.
restaurantPanel.sectionProfileHint: Name, tagline, phone and the categories customers see.
restaurantPanel.sectionLocationHint: City, address, the pin on the map and the delivery radius.
restaurantPanel.sectionDeliveryHint: Minimum order, delivery fee and preparation time.
restaurantPanel.sectionPaymentsHint: The payment methods this restaurant accepts.
restaurantPanel.soundBlockedBody: Until the browser allows sound you will not hear the new-order ring.
restaurantPanel.soundUnavailableBody: This browser cannot play sound — you will not hear the new-order ring. Open the panel in another browser.
restaurantPanel.modifierIntro: A dish’s sizes, extras and choices. The customer picks these before adding it to the basket. A price here is always the DIFFERENCE, never the full price.
restaurantPanel.modifierOptionsRequired: Every group needs at least one option.
restaurantPanel.modifierOptionDuplicate: A group cannot have two options with the same name.
restaurantPanel.modifierAllUnavailable: A required group needs at least one available option.

modifierRuleOption.MANY: May pick as many as they like

modifierRuleHint.ONE_REQUIRED: The customer must pick one or they cannot add the dish. Use it for size — a döner is small or large, never neither.
modifierRuleHint.ONE_OPTIONAL: They may pick one, or none at all. Use it for a sauce — take it or leave it.
modifierRuleHint.MANY: They may pick as many as they like, including all of them. Use it for extras — cheese and meat and pickles.

restaurantPanel.pauseHint: The restaurant re-opens by itself when the time is up — no need to press anything again.
restaurantPanel.prepHowLong: How long will the food take?
restaurantPanel.zonesHint: Cheaper nearby, more further out. With no zones the flat fee above applies at every distance.
restaurantPanel.zonesNone: No zones — the fee and minimum above apply to every address.
restaurantPanel.zoneMinHint: Leave empty to use the restaurant's own minimum

zoneProblem.must-start-at-zero: The first zone must start at 0.
zoneProblem.empty-band: A zone must end further out than it starts.
zoneProblem.gap: There is a gap between zones — each must start where the last one ended.

hoursProblem.ends-before-it-starts: Closing must be later than opening.
hoursProblem.too-long: A shift cannot be longer than a day.
hoursProblem.too-many-shifts: At most two shifts a day.

restaurantPanel.deliveryCodeLockedByPlatform: The platform is currently requiring this of every restaurant, so it cannot be switched off. Normally this setting is yours.
restaurantPanel.cuisineHint: Up to {{max}}. This is what the restaurant IS — the dish types are below.
restaurantPanel.cuisineLegacy: Currently published: {{values}}. What you tick below will replace it.
restaurantPanel.sectionPrintersHint: Separate slips for the kitchen, counter and bar. Auto-print.
restaurantPanel.queueOffline: The order list did not load
restaurantPanel.queueOfflineBody: The connection dropped. This list may look empty while new orders are waiting on the server — check the connection and try again.
restaurantPanel.pendingInvitesHint: These people are not on the team yet. Nothing changes until they accept.
restaurantPanel.modifierExampleBody:
Group 1 — “Size” · the customer must pick one
     Small +0 ₼ · Medium +1.50 ₼ · Large +3 ₼

Group 2 — “Extras” · the customer may pick any number
     Extra meat +2 ₼ · Cheese +1 ₼ · Pickles +0.50 ₼
restaurantPanel.modifierExamplePrice: If the dish itself is 5 ₼, a customer choosing “Large + extra meat” pays 10 ₼ (5 + 3 + 2). So you type 3 into “Large”, not 8.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.fundedByHint: If the platform pays, the discount is deducted from the restaurant's commission bill.
admin.adjustHint: Mistakes are not edited — an opposing entry is added. The log never changes.
admin.ordersSubtitle: Every order on the platform. Active ones update live.
admin.noOrdersHint: Try a different filter or search.
admin.cancelWarning: Order {{code}} will be cancelled. The customer and restaurant are notified.
admin.reasonAudited: The reason is stored in the audit log under your name.
admin.warn_approve: {{name}} will be approved and become visible to customers.
admin.warn_reject: {{name}} will be rejected and cannot reach the panel.
admin.warn_suspend: {{name}} will be suspended and stop taking orders.
admin.warn_activate: {{name}} becomes active again and will take orders.
admin.warn_commission: A new rate for {{name}} applies to future orders only.
admin.rateHint: {{rate}} — on food only; the delivery fee is never charged commission.
admin.commissionPrivate: The commission rate lives in the restaurant’s private record and changes only through the table action.
admin.usersSubtitle: Accounts, roles and suspicious cases. Every change is audited.
admin.roleRestaurantHint: A restaurant role is only ever granted together with a restaurant.
admin.warn_user_status: {{name}}'s account status will change. They notice it immediately.
admin.warn_user_role: {{name}}'s role will change. Their session is revoked and they sign in again.
admin.reviewExplainer: “Under review” is not a ban — the account stays, it just cannot order. It is the first step on a suspicion.
admin.auditSubtitle: Every change made on the platform — who, when and what.
admin.auditImmutable: This log is append-only. Nobody — including a super admin — can delete or change an entry.
admin.auditSearch: Search by action, user or target
admin.ledgerSubtitle: Monthly restaurant invoices: commission, credits and payments.
admin.adjustAmountHint: A minus means the platform owes the restaurant.
admin.warn_invoiced: {{name}}'s invoice will be marked as sent. It is recorded in the audit log.
admin.warn_adjust: A new adjusting entry will be posted for {{name}}. Existing entries are unchanged.
admin.couponsSubtitle: Campaign coupons: value, usage and who funds them.
admin.newCouponSubtitle: A code cannot be edited after it is created — only switched off.
admin.couponLimitHint: The limit counts by phone number and address, not by account — a new account does not unlock the coupon again.
admin.couponNeverDeleted: A coupon is never deleted, only switched off — past redemptions point at this code.
admin.noCouponsHint: Change the filter or the search.
admin.warn_coupon_pause: Coupon {{code}} will be switched off. Customers can no longer apply it.
admin.warn_coupon_resume: Coupon {{code}} works again, as long as its window has not expired.
admin.settingsSubtitle: Platform defaults applied to new restaurants and new orders.
admin.settingsGeneralHint: City, and the starting commission for a new restaurant.
admin.settingsTimingHint: What happens, and when, if nobody picks an order up.
admin.responseWindowHint: After this the order is cancelled automatically.
admin.autoCompleteHint: From delivery until the commission is recorded.
admin.settingsSupportHint: The contact details customers are shown.
admin.settingsPlatformHint: These two switches affect the whole platform.
admin.settingsPaymentsHint: Online payment does not work until a provider is connected — this is the current state, not a switch.
admin.settingsScope: These values apply to new restaurants and new orders only. An order that is already placed keeps the commission it froze at checkout.
admin.settingsMissing: The settings document does not exist yet — saving creates it.
admin.addRestaurantSubtitle: Create the restaurant yourself, without waiting for an application.
admin.addRestaurantIntro: The restaurant becomes active immediately but stays closed. The owner opens it once the menu is ready.
admin.legalNameHint: The name on the contract. Not shown to customers.
admin.ownerPhoneHint: If an account already exists with this number, the restaurant is linked to it. If not, the owner must register with exactly this number.
admin.commissionDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the platform's default rate.
admin.createdClosedHint: The restaurant was created closed. The owner opens it from their panel once the menu is ready.
admin.pinRequired: Place the restaurant on the map.
admin.ownerLinkedBody: An account for {{phone}} was found and made the owner of this restaurant.
admin.ownerMissingBody: The restaurant was created, but no account exists for {{phone}} — nobody can sign in to the panel yet. Assign the role once the owner registers with exactly that number.
admin.addOperatorSubtitle: Move an existing account to the operator role.
admin.operatorPowerWarning: An operator can read every restaurant’s support thread, resolve complaints and see orders. Give it only to someone you know.
admin.operatorLeavesRestaurant: {{name}} is currently linked to a restaurant. Becoming an operator removes that link.
admin.done_operator: The user is now an operator.
admin.platformShareHint: Qapında pays {{platform}}% of the discount, the restaurant pays {{restaurant}}%.
admin.paymentsSubtitle: Online card payments: attempts, confirmations, refunds. Failed and expired attempts are here too.
admin.refundWarning: The remaining {{amount}} for order {{orderId}} will be sent back. This cannot be undone.
admin.noPaymentsHint: Change the filter, search, or date range.
admin.searchPayments: Search by order ID or transaction ref
admin.paymentReferenceHint: The reference on the bank statement. The same reference is never filed twice.
admin.paymentAlreadyRecorded: A payment with this reference has already been recorded.
admin.warn_payment: A payment entry will be added for {{name}}. Entries are never deleted, only corrected by an opposing entry.
admin.onlineCollectedHint: Online takings the platform is holding on behalf of restaurants.
admin.settingsBankHint: Restaurants transfer their commission here. It is shown to them on their settlement screen exactly as typed.
admin.supportCallEnabledHint: When on, a call button appears on the customer and restaurant support screens.
admin.supportCallNeedsNumber: Fill in the support phone first — without a number the button stays hidden.
admin.settingsDangerHint: The action here deletes data permanently. It exists to clear test data before the platform opens.
admin.testDataResetEnabledHint: While this is off the reset button does nothing — the server refuses the call. Switch it off again the day real customers arrive.
admin.testDataResetSaveFirst: Tick the switch and then press "Save": the reset only looks at the switch as stored on the server.
admin.resetIntro: Orders, payments, settlements, complaints, support tickets, reviews and notifications — whatever you select is deleted permanently.
admin.resetBody: The data you select will be deleted permanently. To continue, type the platform name — {{name}} — below.
admin.resetDisabled: The reset is switched off. Turn on "Allow the test-data reset" above and save the settings.
admin.resetKeptAudit: The reset itself is written to the audit log, and that entry survives.
admin.resetIrreversible: {{count}} documents will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
admin.resetTypeNameHint: The name has to be typed out in full, as a wall against a mis-aimed click.
admin.resetPartial: The budget ran out — {{count}} documents deleted. Press the button again for the rest.
admin.resetPartialHint: {{count}} documents deleted, and there are still some left. Running it again is safe — press the button to continue.
admin.reportSkipped: {{count}} orders could not be read and are not counted in these figures.
admin.commissionScopeNote: This rate applies to new restaurants only. An existing restaurant’s rate is changed on the Restaurants screen, and no rate change ever touches an order that has already been placed.
admin.acceptingNewRestaurantsHint: Off means no new restaurant applications are accepted.
admin.maintenanceModeHint: On closes the platform: no customer can place a new order — the button is not merely hidden, the server refuses. The restaurant, courier, operator and admin panels keep working, and orders already in flight finish normally.
admin.paymentOnlineHint: Online card can only be switched on once a payment provider is configured on the server.
admin.paymentLastOne: At least one payment method has to stay on.
admin.maintenanceWarning: Turning this on stops every new order across the platform. Orders already placed are untouched.
admin.maintenanceMessageHint: Left empty, the standard sentence is shown. Customers see this on the home page and at checkout.
admin.maintenanceUntilHint: Optional. Left empty, no time is promised. A time in the past, or more than 30 days out, is ignored.
admin.maintenanceReasonHint: Written to the audit log: who closed the platform, when, and why.
admin.couponUniqueCustomersHint: How many separate accounts have used it.
admin.couponPlatformFundedHint: Qapında pays this, and it is deducted from the restaurant's settlement.
admin.couponTruncated: Heavily used — the figures cover the first 1000 redemptions.
admin.couponCountMismatch: The counter says {{counter}} but the records say {{counted}}. Worth checking.
admin.couponNoRedemptions: Nobody has used this coupon yet.
admin.couponEditSubtitle: The code, the type and the funding stay as they are — every other term can change.
admin.couponImmutableHint: The code is what every past redemption points at, and the funding decides whose account those discounts were charged to. So these three do not change — if the terms need rewriting, switch this coupon off and create a new one.
admin.couponValuePercentHint: What percentage of the order is taken off.
admin.couponValueFixedHint: The fixed amount taken off the order.
admin.minSubtotalHint: The coupon only works on orders above this amount.
admin.usageLimitTotalHint: Total redemptions across all customers. Empty means no limit.
admin.usageLimitPerCustomerHint: How many times one person may use it.
admin.couponValidUntilHint: Valid until the end of the chosen day.
admin.couponNamedCustomerIdsHint: One ID per line. Empty means the coupon is open to everybody. Filled in, nobody else can see or use it.
admin.firstOrderOnlyHint: Only for customers who have never ordered before.
admin.couponRestaurantsRequired: At least one restaurant must be chosen — restaurant-funded and shared campaigns are billed to the restaurant.
admin.couponCodeHint: The customer types this code at checkout. It cannot be changed once created.
admin.couponTypeHint: Percent takes a share of the order; fixed takes an amount in manat; free delivery is worth whatever the delivery fee is.
admin.reportRateDefault: No agreed rate — the platform default applies.
admin.reportCancellationsHint: Rejected, cancelled, unanswered and failed deliveries.
admin.reportSettlementUnavailable: The settlement could not be read.
admin.reportConsistencyNote: These figures come from the same server calls as the restaurant's own Hesabat and Hesablaşma screens, so the two cannot disagree.
admin.reportNoOrders: This restaurant has no orders yet.
admin.grantCouponNoneExisting: There are no personal coupons yet. Create one below.
admin.grantCouponExplainer: The coupon is visible only to this customer and only they can use it. One use.
admin.done_coupon_deactivated: The last customer was removed, so the coupon was switched off.
admin.couponEveryCustomerHint: This coupon is open to every customer. To make a personal one, grant it from the Users page.
admin.couponAddCustomerHint: Enter a number that has an account.
admin.couponLastCustomerHint: Removing the last customer switches the coupon off.
admin.searchRebuildHint: Needed once after an update. Menus saved earlier are findable only by whole words; this makes them findable by a prefix and by the restaurant's name too.
admin.cancelWindowHint: A customer may cancel within this time — while the restaurant has not accepted. {{min}}–{{max}} minutes.
admin.homeCategoriesHint: Which categories to show, and in what order. The order you pick them is the order on screen.
admin.homeCategoriesAll: Nothing selected — all of them are shown.
admin.warn_feature: {{name}} will carry the Featured badge on the home screen.
admin.warn_unfeature: {{name}} will no longer carry the badge.
admin.locksHint: Check whether a phone number or email is really taken.
admin.locksIntro: Every phone number and email has a lock — that is what keeps "one customer, one account" true. If an account is deleted straight out of Firestore the lock stays behind, and the number's real owner can never register again. This shows what is behind the lock.
admin.locksNoInput: Enter a phone number or an email.
admin.locksNoLock: No lock — registration with this number is open.
admin.locksLiveHint: This number belongs to a real, existing account. A live lock cannot be released here: doing so would hand somebody's number to another person. If the account itself must go, the holder requests deletion first and the account is then anonymised.
admin.locksStale: The lock is dead — there is no account behind it.
admin.locksStaleHint: This lock protects nobody and blocks the number. Once removed, its owner can register again immediately. The action is written to the audit log.
admin.locksReleased: Lock released. Registration is possible again.
admin.locksReasonNO_ACCOUNT: The account it names was deleted
admin.locksReasonMOVED_ON: The account no longer carries this number
admin.deliveryCodeAlways: Force the handover code on every restaurant
admin.deliveryCodeAlwaysHint: Normally the restaurant decides — each one switches it on or off in its own panel, and new ones start with it on. Ticking this overrides their choice and requires a code on every delivery. Use it only for a platform-wide problem.
admin.warn_remove: {{name}} will be removed from the platform. This cannot be undone.
admin.removeRestaurantWarning: The menu — every category and product — is deleted for good. Staff and couriers are unlinked and lose panel access. The restaurant disappears from the shopfront, from search and from every list. Order, settlement and review records are kept for accounting and are not deleted.
admin.removeRestaurantConfirm: Type the restaurant’s name to confirm: {{name}}
admin.changePhoneWarning: This changes who the account belongs to. The old number is released, the new one is bound to this account, and every open session is signed out. Be sure you know the person.
admin.phoneMovedPartly: The number changed on the platform but not in Firebase Auth — the person still cannot sign in. Try again in a moment.
admin.statusChangedPartly: The status was changed, but the sign-in block could not be applied — this account has no reachable Firebase Auth record. It can do nothing on the platform, but it can still open the app. Check the logs.
admin.warn_user_phone: Changing the telephone number on {{name}}'s account.
admin.sortScopeHint: Sorts the 200 accounts on screen only.
admin.counterBackfillHint: Every completed order raises that customer’s order count and spend. This fills in the history for accounts created before those fields existed — without it they all show a dash in the admin list. Pressing it twice is harmless.
admin.featureSponsoredNote: The customer sees "Reklam" on the card. That is not optional: showing a sold slot as our own recommendation tells customers something untrue about the ordering.
admin.featureFeeHint: Added to this month's invoice alongside the commission. Leave blank to charge nothing.
admin.resetLockedHint: This button is locked. Turn on “Allow test data reset” above, then press Save at the bottom of the page — the button becomes available after that.

helpCentre.title: Help
helpCentre.intro: The questions we get asked most. If your answer isn't here, open a support ticket above, or call the restaurant directly using the number on your order screen.
helpCentre.orderingActiveQ: How many orders can I have open at once?
helpCentre.orderingActiveA: You can have at most 3 active orders at the same time. One of them has to be delivered or closed before you can place another.
helpCentre.orderingCancelA: Yes, as long as the restaurant hasn't accepted it yet. But if you've cancelled 3 orders yourself in the last 7 days, ordering is paused until that window clears — cancellations the restaurant made, or orders that simply expired, never count against you.
helpCentre.orderingChangeQ: Can I add to or change my order after placing it?
helpCentre.orderingChangeA: Not from the app — a submitted order can't be edited. To change anything, call the restaurant directly using the number on the order screen.
helpCentre.deliveryWhoA: Qapında has no courier fleet of its own — every order is delivered by the restaurant's own courier. That's why delivery speed varies from one restaurant to another.
helpCentre.deliveryTrackQ: How do I know where my order is?
helpCentre.deliveryTrackA: The order status on the "My orders" screen shows the stage it's at. Qapında doesn't track the courier live, so the fastest way to get an exact location is to call the restaurant using the button on that screen.
helpCentre.deliveryLateQ: My order is late, what do I do?
helpCentre.deliveryLateA: Call the restaurant using the number on your order screen — their own courier is handling delivery, so they can tell you what's happening fastest. If you can't get an answer, open a support ticket from that order screen: it reaches an operator with the order already attached.
helpCentre.paymentHowA: You can pay at the door, in cash or by card. Paying by card online appears on the checkout screen only where the platform has a payment provider configured and the restaurant accepts it.
helpCentre.paymentRefundQ: My order came wrong, can I get my money back?
helpCentre.paymentRefundA: Since payment goes straight to the restaurant or courier at the door, Qapında never holds your money and so it can't refund it itself. That gets settled with the restaurant — reporting the problem sends your complaint straight to them.
helpCentre.problemsHowQ: How do I report a problem with an order?
helpCentre.problemsHowA: Open the order under "My orders" and tap "Report a problem". Describe what happened, add a photo if you'd like. You can do this within 2 days of delivery — after that the form closes for that order.
helpCentre.problemsOutcomeQ: What happens after I report a problem?
helpCentre.problemsOutcomeA: Your complaint reaches the restaurant and the Qapında team right away, so they can reach out to you. Since payment happens at the door, Qapında doesn't refund you, but when it's warranted it can claw back the commission it charged the restaurant on that order.
helpCentre.reviewsWhoQ: Can I leave a review for a restaurant?
helpCentre.reviewsWhoA: Only once your order has been delivered, and only once per order. Until an order is delivered, you won't see an option to review that restaurant for it.
helpCentre.reviewsWindowQ: How long do I have to write a review?
helpCentre.reviewsWindowA: You can leave a review within 30 days of delivery.
helpCentre.accountAddressQ: How do I change my delivery address?
helpCentre.accountAddressA: From "My addresses" you can add a new one, edit an existing one, or change your default address at any time.
helpCentre.accountLangQ: How do I change the app's language?
helpCentre.accountLangA: In the "Preferences" section of the Account page you can switch between Azerbaijani, Russian and English.
helpCentre.accountDeleteA: Yes, use "Delete my account" at the bottom of the Account page. Once the request is confirmed it can't be undone.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers about ordering, payment, delivery and your account
faq.noResultsHint: Try different words, or contact support.
faq.stillStuck: Did not find the answer? Write to support from Account → Help — you will get a notification when an operator replies.

howToOrder.q: How do I place an order?
howToOrder.a: Pick a restaurant from the home screen, add dishes to the basket and check out. On the payment screen choose the delivery address and the payment method, then confirm. You need an account with your phone number to order.

minimumOrder.a: Each restaurant sets its own minimum. It is shown on the restaurant page and in the basket; below it, checkout stays disabled.

trackOrder.q: How do I follow my order?
trackOrder.a: On the order’s own page under My orders, where the status updates live: accepted, being prepared, on the way, delivered. While an order is active a short bar at the bottom of the screen takes you straight there. No notification is sent about the status — the page updates itself.

orderTime.a: The estimate is calculated when the restaurant accepts the order and is shown on the order page. It depends on the kitchen's preparation time and the distance, and can stretch at peak hours.

changeOrder.q: Can I change what I ordered?
changeOrder.a: Not once the order has been sent. If the restaurant has not accepted it yet you can cancel and order again; if it has, call the restaurant directly.

paymentMethods.a: Cash at the door, card at the door, and card online. Each restaurant chooses the first two for itself. Paying by card online appears only when the platform has a payment provider configured and the restaurant accepts it, so for some restaurants the option is not there at all.

cardAtDoor.q: Can I pay by card at the door?
cardAtDoor.a: Yes, if the restaurant accepts it. You pay on the courier's terminal at your door. If the option is not on the payment screen, that restaurant does not accept it.

onlineCard.q: How does paying by card online work?
onlineCard.a: Where the option is offered: card details are entered on the bank’s own page and are never stored by Qapında. The restaurant does not see the order until the bank confirms the payment. If it fails, the order stays unpaid — you can cancel it at any time and try again.

receipt.a: Yes. Every order page itemises the total — dishes, delivery fee, discount — and stays available as the receipt.

whoDelivers.a: The restaurant's own courier. Qapında runs no delivery fleet: we pass the order to the restaurant and the restaurant sends the food with its own driver. That is why delivery times and conditions depend on the restaurant.

deliveryFee.a: Each restaurant sets its own fee, and it is shown in the basket before you confirm. Some restaurants deliver free above a certain amount.

deliveryRadius.q: Why do some restaurants not deliver to me?
deliveryRadius.a: Each restaurant draws its delivery area on the map — a point and a radius. If your address's pin falls outside that circle the restaurant cannot deliver to it, and the payment screen says so.

courierContact.q: How do I reach the courier?
courierContact.a: The courier calls the number saved on the address. From your side the fastest route is the restaurant's number on the order page — the courier is theirs.

notHome.q: What if I am not home when it arrives?
notHome.a: The courier calls the number on the address. With no answer the order may go back to the restaurant, which is why writing the entrance, the floor and the intercom in the courier note is worth the few seconds.

howCoupons.q: How do I use a coupon?
howCoupons.a: Enter the code on the payment screen and apply it — the discount comes off immediately. Coupons available to you are listed under My coupons.

couponNotWorking.q: Why is my coupon not working?
couponNotWorking.a: The usual reasons: it has expired, the minimum is not met, it belongs to another restaurant, it is first-order only, or it has already been used. The screen names the exact one.

couponPerOrder.q: How many coupons can one order take?

cancelOrder.a: Only before the restaurant accepts it, and only within the first 3 minutes of placing it. The moment the restaurant accepts, the window closes, because the food is already being cooked. One exception: an online order whose payment has not gone through can be cancelled at any time — no kitchen has been told and no money has moved. After that, contact support.

restaurantRejected.q: What if the restaurant does not accept my order?
restaurantRejected.a: If the restaurant refuses it, or does not answer within the time it is given, the order is cancelled and you see that on the order’s own page — no notification is sent. If you paid online, the full amount is refunded.

refundTime.q: When do I get my money back?
refundTime.a: For online payments the refund starts as soon as the order is cancelled; how long it takes to appear on your card is up to your bank, usually 1–7 working days. With cash or card at the door nothing was charged, so there is nothing to refund.

somethingWrong.q: What if something is missing or wrong?
somethingWrong.a: File a complaint from the order page: choose the reason, write a short explanation and attach a photo if you can. An operator reviews it and you are notified of the outcome.

contactRestaurant.q: How do I talk to the restaurant?
contactRestaurant.a: The restaurant's phone number is on the order page. For anything about the food, the preparation time or the courier, calling them directly is the fastest route.

contactSupport.q: How do I reach Qapında support?
contactSupport.a: Open a ticket from Account → Help. It goes to an operator, and you are notified when they reply — one of the notifications you still get, because it is not about an order’s status. Once the ticket is closed it appears under Settings → Feedback, where you can rate how it was handled.

complaint.q: What is the difference between a complaint and a support ticket?
complaint.a: A complaint is about one specific order — missing food, a delay, quality — and can end in compensation. A support ticket is for account, payment and general questions.

addPin.q: How do I add an address?
addPin.a: Account → My addresses → Add a new address. Search for the address or use your current location, drag the pin to the exact spot, and finally fill in the building, flat, floor and contact number.

whyPin.q: Why must I place a pin on the map?
whyPin.a: Whether a restaurant delivers to you is calculated from that pin's coordinates. An address without one cannot be ordered to, which is why pinning is part of adding an address rather than an extra.

addressPhone.q: What is the phone number on an address for?
addressPhone.a: It is the number the courier is given for that delivery. Sending an order to your parents' flat or an office, you can put the number of whoever will open the door. Left empty, your account number is used.

editAddress.q: How do I edit or delete an address?
editAddress.a: Use the pencil to edit and the bin to delete in My addresses. Past orders do not change — each keeps the address exactly as it was when the order was placed.

oneAccount.q: How many accounts can one phone number have?
oneAccount.a: One. Each number belongs to a single account, and a number already working as a restaurant, courier or operator cannot also open a customer account.

changePhone.q: Can I change my phone number?
changePhone.a: The number is the key to the account and cannot be changed by you. Contact support to have it changed.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: With Delete account at the bottom of the Account page. Your name, phone, email and addresses are removed; order records are kept without a name on them, because accounting requires it.

notificationsOff.q: How do I turn notifications off?
notificationsOff.a: Settings → Notifications. There is nothing there for order statuses, because those notifications are not sent at all any more. What you can switch off is campaigns, new restaurants and the review reminder; a refund and the outcome of your complaint cannot be switched off, because not knowing about those costs you.

noStatusNotifications.q: Why don’t I get notifications about my order’s status?
noStatusNotifications.a: Because they were removed entirely. Every step used to send one — accepted, being prepared, on the way, delivered — and now you follow the order on its own page instead, which updates live. What still arrives as a notification is campaigns, support replies, the outcome of a complaint, and money coming back.

printStations.limitTitle: Important: a browser cannot choose the printer
printStations.limitBody: This is not a Qapında limitation — no website can pick which printer a job goes to; the browser always sends to the operating system’s default. What we can do is print the slips separately and in sequence. Normally a dialogue opens for each one and you pick the printer.
printStations.kioskTitle: To make three printers genuinely work (Chrome)
printStations.kioskBody:
1. Create a separate Chrome profile for each slip.
2. In each profile set that slip’s printer as the default.
3. Launch Chrome as: chrome --kiosk-printing
4. Open the panel in each profile and tick "Auto-print" for that slip only.

After that the slips come out with no dialogue, each on its own printer.
